candidates.statement: Payment service calls from order time out (ReadTimeout, transport error) at ~2s, causing order and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502. Traces show payment POST /v1/authorizations erroring while inventory/redis succeed, and checkout p95 ~2425ms with 16 502s in 60s.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side latency source (saturation vs network) not directly observed; no payment service metrics available.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s align with payment ReadTimeout errors in traces; inventory and redis calls succeed, isolating the failing dependency to payment. Gateway metrics confirm checkout 502s and elevated p95 latency. Payment-side telemetry is absent, so the bounded candidate is downstream payment latency.
